item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: Native universal Mac release, signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. App and DMG tickets are stapled and Gatekeeper accepts both. Includes the current Klaudimero interface and encrypted push support; push delivery requires the separately configured relay.

item.title: Version 0.1.17
item.description: Native universal macOS SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, built with the macOS 27 SDK. Dedicated desktop workspace with three-column Chats, native Bots and Jobs tables, Jobs inspector, standard Settings window and keyboard commands. Includes compact agent handoffs, reasoning and tools disclosures, secure input, guarded chat deletion and server-backed archive/restore. Internal build signed with Apple Development, published without notarization at the owner’s request; Gatekeeper does not accept this build automatically. Notarization remains tracked in GitHub issue #1.

item.title: Version 0.1.10
item.description: Native navigation headers and model subtitles, grouped settings with dedicated server details, and native chat Rename/Delete actions. Includes the matching iPhone navigation and haptics update.

item.title: Version 0.1.9
item.description: Fix duplicate replies and flickering reasoning, tighten composer spacing, and dismiss the keyboard on chat taps and scrolling while keeping replies visible.

item.title: Version 0.1.9
item.description: Fix duplicate replies and flickering reasoning, tighten composer spacing, and dismiss the keyboard when tapping or scrolling the chat.

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description: Improve chat updates during tools and handoffs, add chats grouped by bot and latest-message previews, and fix photo sending.

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description: Improve chat updates during tools and handoffs, add chats grouped by bot and latest-message previews, and fix photo sending.

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description: Fix photo sending compatibility with Hermes. Preview photos, PDFs, and text in the composer and chat, including saved conversations.

item.title: Version 0.1.6
item.description: Jobs now load independently of profile discovery. Expanded multiline composer with separate model settings and context usage. Plus attaches photos and files. Bot taps open the main Bot Chat. Customize bot symbols, colors, or photos per server on this device.

item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description: Cadu-inspired Bots, Chats, Jobs and More navigation. Warm canvas, floating phone dock, compact composer, inline tools and approvals, and iPad/Mac sidebar. Read-only Hermes schedules and Tasks for chats running in Klaudimero. Original name and logo preserved. Old-chat editing still awaits the Hermes backend fix.

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description: Choose models per conversation using the Hermes server catalog and confirmation prompts. Leading-aligned tool output, inline thinking, and Stop in the composer. Existing old-chat editing still awaits the Hermes backend fix.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description: Fix 404 errors when opening or deleting empty chats before their first message. Clean up empty-chat connections and distinguish a missing chat from saved history the Hermes runtime refuses to edit. Older history may still require backend migration.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description: Fix chat deletion and renaming with current Hermes backends. Update session-edit compatibility checks and prevent duplicate edits after connection failures.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description: Klaudimero name and original logo restored. Sign in to your configurable Hermes dashboard with username and password or a dashboard access token. Agent profiles are discovered from the server and remain separate from saved connections. Updated streaming chat, session resume, stop, and one-time approvals. Universal Intel and Apple Silicon build.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description: First native Hermes client for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Klaudimero-inspired Today and chat views, configurable agent profiles, streaming Markdown replies, tool activity, approvals, and Keychain credentials. Requires the Hermes API server. Internal Apple Development signing with hardened runtime; not notarized.
